lesson.title: Welcome & Setup — Tuner & metronome basics
objectives: Keep changes clean before adding speed

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Tuner & metronome basics
exercises.purpose: Tuner & metronome basics with no chord pressure — build the habit.
exercises.coaching: No chord yet. Tuner & metronome basics. Keep your shoulders down and your grip loose — tension is the enemy of flow.

exercises.name: Timing check
exercises.purpose: Lock the pulse with the free metronome.
exercises.coaching: Find the beat first. Everything we build later sits on top of a steady pulse — do not skip this.
